active_work_item.reason: Independent QA rejected PR #18 at exact head 276f5a56b1d413541c1885b04e19f6848afc78ef. The cycle-3 repair blocks neutral same-field evidence but still allows unrelated conditional wording to establish a potential-risk condition. Example: canonical evidence 'Total $1000.00 subject to scheduling availability' can support the claim 'The quoted total may be inaccurate' because claimSupportedByEvidence matches the total anchor and riskConditionSupported accepts any riskBearingLanguage such as 'subject to', even though the condition concerns scheduling rather than total accuracy. This violates AC4 source grounding and AC2 false-positive risk coverage. Exact-head CI 34653889070 is green, so this is a quality-coverage failure, not a build failure. This is the fourth QA failure on the same source-grounding root issue following the PM-authorized bounded cycle-3 repair; protocol requires escalation rather than another unrestricted Builder loop. PM must authorize a redesigned semantic/structured grounding approach and bounded regression before Builder resumes. No paid/live eval or YELLOW/RED action was performed.
